parts.text:
Greetings, Saad of Krypton! Welcome to Earth. 

It is an honor to meet a survivor of such a legendary planet. I must ask—how are you adjusting to our yellow sun? You must be feeling incredibly powerful here compared to back home under Rao, your red giant. 

Just a friendly piece of advice: if anyone hands you a glowing green rock, you might want to take a few steps back! 

How can I help you on your earthly journey today?
